note.self: Germany: 27+ month queue for self-funded Master's. Italy: VFS via Universitaly, summer rush. Hungary: embassy route, fairly quick. France: Campus France, 3 interviews, about 3 months.
note.sch: German-gov / EU-funded scholars skip Germany's queue. Stipendium Hungaricum and Eiffel holders get priority handling.

note.self: Germany: no tuition but €11,904 blocked. Italy: income-based fees, cheap rent. Hungary: €3–5k fees, cheapest living. France: about €3,950/yr fees.
note.sch: Erasmus €1,400/month, DAAD ~€992, Eiffel ~€1,181. Hungary's stipend (HUF 43,700 ≈ €110) covers little beyond the dorm.

note.self: Italy's DSU is income-based, so most Bangladeshi families qualify. Stipendium Hungaricum is open to Bangladesh with ministry nomination. German and French awards are few and competitive.
note.sch: Scenario assumes you already hold the award.

note.self: Germany: spouse visa with A1 German and funds. Italy: ~€10,650/yr income + housing. Hungary: no family reunification for study permits. France: spouse needs a separate visitor visa, no work.
note.sch: Same rules; a stipend helps show funds in Germany and Italy.

note.self: Germany: 18-month job-search permit, Frankfurt. France: 1-year post-study permit, Paris finance. Italy: 9–12 months. Hungary: small market, low pay.
Germany: Frankfurt, Magdeburg, FU Berlin. Italy: Bologna, Turin, Milan, Pavia. Hungary: Corvinus, Debrecen. France: strong but many English finance MSc are at fee-charging schools.
German 1.79 clears most cut-offs. Italian pre-evaluation and Hungarian entrance interviews are broader. French public Master's are selective.
All teach in English; part-time jobs and paperwork need the local language, most of all in France.

self.headline: Self-funded, Italy is your best 2027 route. Apply to Stipendium Hungaricum and Erasmus Mundus in parallel; Germany's Dhaka visa queue (27+ months) blocks a self-funded start.

routes.title: Italy with a DSU regional grant
routes.detail: Apply Jan–Apr 2027, pre-enrol on Universitaly. DSU pays up to about €8,246/year plus a fee waiver if your family's income qualifies.

routes.title: Erasmus Mundus + Stipendium Hungaricum, in parallel
routes.detail: Both are free to apply and close in January. Hungary is fully funded, but your wife can't join on family reunification while you study.

routes.title: Germany, self-funded
routes.detail: Admission in mid-2027 means a visa appointment around late 2029. Keep Germany for an award or a job move after an EU degree.

next: Take IELTS on 5 Dec; book a backup date in January.
Shortlist 3 Erasmus Mundus programmes; submit before 7–27 Jan.
Stipendium Hungaricum: register on DreamApply when the call opens (Nov) and pick 2 finance programmes; deadline expected 15 Jan.
Start Italian paperwork: Declaration of Value or CIMEA, and legalised family income papers for DSU.

sch.headline: With an EU- or government-funded award, Germany moves to first, France second: both skip the queue and have the stronger job markets.

routes.title: Germany on Erasmus / DAAD
routes.detail: Funded scholars are processed right after Consular Services Portal registration. Arrive Oct 2027.

routes.title: France on Eiffel, or Italy on Erasmus
routes.detail: Eiffel covers ~€1,181/month and fees; universities nominate you, usually by January.

routes.title: Hungary on Stipendium Hungaricum
routes.detail: Fees and dorm covered, but the stipend is small and your wife can't join on family reunification.

next: Pick Erasmus programmes with a German or French partner (EPOG has both).
Ask target French universities how they nominate for Eiffel and their internal deadline.
Keep the Italy applications running until an award letter arrives.

signals.title: Dhaka: self-funded Master's visas wait more than 27 months
signals.detail: The German Embassy says the wait for students without a German or EU scholarship is more than 27 months and is not expected to fall. Registration opens only after admission.

signals.title: German-gov or EU-funded scholars skip the queue
signals.detail: Scholarship applicants are processed right after CSP registration. Only German-government or EU-funded awards (DAAD, Erasmus Mundus) count.

signals.title: Blocked account stays at €11,904 (€992/month)
signals.detail: Minimum balance for the student visa, per the Dhaka embassy page. About 16.7 lakh BDT at 140.

signals.title: Bavaria: more universities may charge non-EU fees
signals.detail: TUM charges €4,000–6,000 per semester for Master's; one tracker says FAU starts from summer 2027. Baden-Württemberg charges €1,500. Other states stay free.

signals.title: Italy: VFS emails Universitaly registrants for visa appointments
signals.detail: No separate booking. Deadline for 2026/27 applications is 30 Nov 2026. A CIMEA certificate or Declaration of Value is required; relatives may guarantee funds.

signals.title: Italian embassy promises to clear ~20,000 pending Bangladeshi visas
signals.detail: Mostly work visas, but it strains the same embassy. Expect slow summer appointments; register on Universitaly early.

signals.title: DSU 2026/27 top grant about €8,246/year (ER.GO, Padova)
signals.detail: Income-based; non-EU students compete on equal terms using an ISEE parificato. 2027/28 calls expected from June 2027.

signals.title: Italy spouse reunification: about €10,652/year income
signals.detail: Based on the 2026 social allowance (€7,101) plus 50%. Also needs housing and a residence permit valid for at least a year.

signals.title: Invest Your Talent in Italy: next call expected early 2027
signals.detail: Last round ran 20 Apr – 11 May 2026. Needs B2 English, birth on/after 1 Jan 2000; can't be combined with DSU.

signals.title: Stipendium Hungaricum 2027/28: deadline expected 15 Jan 2027
signals.detail: The official call isn't out yet; last year's closed 15 Jan at 14:00 CET. Apply on DreamApply and get nominated by Bangladesh's Ministry of Education.

signals.title: Stipendium Hungaricum pays HUF 43,700/month + dorm
signals.detail: Tuition is free and you get a dorm place or HUF 40,000/month for housing. The cash stipend is small, so plan your own living money.

signals.title: Hungary: no family reunification for study permits
signals.detail: A Hungarian embassy checklist says family members of students can't apply on family reunification. Confirm with the embassy covering Bangladesh.

signals.title: France: non-EU Master's fees about €3,950/yr; exemptions capped
signals.detail: A May 2026 decree limits universities to exempting 30% of non-EU students in 2026/27, falling to 20%. Eiffel and French-government scholars pay nothing.

signals.title: France: the student visa doesn't cover your wife
signals.detail: Campus France Bangladesh says the student visa is for the student only; a spouse applies separately as a long-stay visitor and can't work.

signals.title: France raised the student-visa funds requirement from 1 Aug 2026
signals.detail: The old figure was €615/month. Check the new amount on the Campus France Bangladesh checklist before you plan.

signals.title: Erasmus Mundus 2027 cycle is open: most deadlines Dec – Jan
signals.detail: Up to 3 applications. €1,400/month plus fees and travel. A win also clears the German visa queue.

signals.title: Finland bill: students' families wait 1 year before applying
signals.detail: Proposed to start 5 Apr 2027. With €10–12k fees, it's why Finland isn't in your top four.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus EPOG (economic policies, finance track)
picks.why: German and French partners, so a win can mean Germany without the visa queue.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus GrEnFIn (energy markets and finance)
picks.why: Bologna-led with a Paris track. Search 'GrEnFIn' in the catalogue for the official page.

picks.name: Erasmus Mundus catalogue: finance, data, management
picks.why: Finish a shortlist of 3 by this date.

picks.name: University of Bologna: MSc Quantitative Finance
picks.funding: Income-based fees; ER.GO DSU up to ~€8,246/yr

picks.name: University of Turin: Quantitative Finance and Insurance
picks.why: English B2 checked at interview; Turin is cheaper than Milan.

picks.name: University of Milan: Finance and Economics (MEF)
picks.why: Last cycle's non-EU window was 22 Jan – 30 Apr.

picks.name: University of Pavia: MSc Finance
picks.why: Small city, lower rent, near Milan's finance jobs.

picks.name: DSU regional grant (ER.GO, ESU Padova, EDISU …)
picks.why: Calls open around June 2027; start the legalised family income papers in spring.

picks.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy
picks.why: Next call expected early 2027; check the country list and age limit.

picks.name: Stipendium Hungaricum (Hungarian government)
picks.why: Bangladesh is a partner country; you also need the Ministry of Education's nomination.

picks.name: Corvinus University of Budapest: MSc Finance
picks.why: Hungary's top business school; pick it as one of your two SH choices.

picks.name: University of Debrecen: business and finance Master's
picks.why: Large international intake and a South Asia office.

picks.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship (Master's)
picks.why: Your French university nominates you; ask each programme for its internal deadline (usually Dec–Jan).

picks.name: Campus France Bangladesh: Études en France
picks.why: Every French application from Bangladesh goes through this portal and its interview.

picks.name: Goethe Univ. Frankfurt: MSc Money, Macro and Finance
picks.why: Realistic for 2027 only with a funded scholarship because of the visa queue.

picks.name: Univ. of Magdeburg: International Management and Finance
picks.why: Good fit for your grades; pair it with an Erasmus or DAAD award.

picks.name: Freie Universität Berlin: MSc Finance
picks.why: Berlin jobs but high rent. Confirm the 2027 date.

picks.name: DAAD database: English, tuition-free finance MSc
picks.funding: No tuition outside Bavaria and Baden-Württemberg
picks.why: Target date for the German shortlist.
